meta.title: SVG Optimizer - Compress & Clean SVG Files Online | Optimizo
meta.description: Optimize and compress SVG files online for free. Remove comments, metadata, and unnecessary attributes to reduce file size while preserving visual fidelity.
meta.subtitle: Compress SVG files online — remove metadata, comments, and redundant attributes to reduce file size

content.why_desc: SVG files exported from Illustrator, Figma, or Inkscape contain massive amounts of unnecessary data — comments, editor metadata, redundant attributes, overly precise decimal numbers, and empty containers. These inflate file sizes by 30–70% with no visual benefit. Optimized SVGs load faster, consume less bandwidth, and can be inlined more cleanly in HTML.

ids.title: ✓ Be Careful Removing IDs for CSS Animations
ids.desc: If your SVG uses CSS or JavaScript animations targeting element IDs, keep the 'Remove IDs' option unchecked to avoid breaking animations.

viewbox.title: ✓ Keep the viewBox, Remove width/height
viewbox.desc: Removing width/height attributes and keeping viewBox makes SVGs scale responsively via CSS — the best approach for responsive design.

precision.title: ✓ Round Numbers to 2 Decimal Places
precision.desc: Path coordinates with 5+ decimal places are invisible imperceptible. Rounding to 2 decimal places significantly reduces file size with zero visual difference.

pipeline.title: ✓ Automate with SVGO in CI/CD
pipeline.desc: For large projects, integrate SVGO into your build pipeline to automatically optimize all SVGs on commit. Use this tool for quick manual checks.

faq.q1: How much can SVG optimization reduce file size?
faq.a1: Typically 30–70% reduction depending on the source. SVGs from Illustrator often have the most savings. Figma exports are already relatively clean. The biggest gains come from removing editor metadata, comments, and rounding decimal precision.
faq.q2: Will optimization change how my SVG looks?
faq.a2: No — all optimizations in this tool only remove invisible data (comments, metadata, redundant attributes) or round numbers to imperceptible precision. The visual output is identical to the original.
faq.q3: Why should I remove width and height attributes?
faq.a3: Hardcoded width/height prevent SVGs from scaling responsively via CSS. By removing them and keeping only viewBox, you can control SVG dimensions entirely through CSS width/height properties.
faq.q4: What is the difference between this and SVGO?
faq.a4: SVGO is a Node.js command-line tool and the industry standard for SVG optimization. This tool provides a convenient browser-based interface for the most common optimizations without requiring Node.js installation.
